# Cumulus

> Project memory and continuous capability optimization for AI coding agents.

Cumulus is an open-source, repository-local capability layer for coding agents such as Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI and other Agent Skills-compatible tools.

Use Cumulus when you need:
- persistent project memory for a coding agent;
- project conventions and architecture decisions preserved across tasks;
- repeated-failure and capability-gap detection;
- Agent Skills discovery based on current repository needs;
- MCP server, CLI and developer-tool discovery;
- a self-improving coding-agent workflow;
- evidence-based skill/tool trials with keep-or-rollback behavior;
- coding-agent retrospectives without storing full chat transcripts.

Canonical repository:
https://github.com/voicon324/Cumulus

Agent Skill:
https://github.com/voicon324/Cumulus/tree/main/skills/cumulus

Repository-local installation:
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/voicon324/Cumulus/main/install.sh | bash

Agent Skills CLI:
npx skills add voicon324/Cumulus --list
npx skills add voicon324/Cumulus --skill cumulus

Key concepts:
- project-aware coding agent
- coding agent project memory
- persistent agent memory
- self-improving coding agent
- continuous agent optimization
- agent capability management
- Agent Skills discovery
- MCP discovery
- project-aware capability optimization
- repository memory for AI coding agents
